operation_contract: source_id is the canonical source identity. capability_id declares the default logical operation; read means read public source content, never a write. --capability selects another exact adapter operation. authentication_required null means the catalog has no additional auth constraint; the current-session adapter must still prove authenticated or explicitly not-required access.
